criteria.emergency_hook: The presented state jointly supports removing the pitcher immediately, before warm-up is complete, because of what the presented numbers show.
criteria.other: None of the listed removal decisions is supported by the presented state.
criteria.pull_now: The presented state jointly supports removing the pitcher before this plate appearance is completed.
criteria.ride: The presented state jointly supports letting the pitcher face this plate appearance without restriction.
criteria.soft_hook: The presented state jointly supports warming a reliever now while leaving the current pitcher in.

question.instructions: Judge the supplied precomputed numeric state for this in-PA pitcher-removal decision. Do not calculate or infer any statistic that is not presented.
